main.body: A Houthi drone struck a tower in Riyadh's King Abdullah Financial District, Saudi civil defence said, injuring 11 people, two of them Indian nationals. It is the second hit on the district's landmark tower in less than a week. The UAE condemned the attack.
main.headline: HOUTHIS HIT RIYADH'S TALLEST TOWER — 11 HURT

main.body: Australia and Solomon Islands signed a sweeping treaty in Canberra: no foreign military base will be built in the Pacific nation, and Australia becomes its main security partner. PM Matthew Wale flew in with 15 ministers; the deal is read as a setback for China.
main.headline: SOLOMONS SIGN PACT: NO FOREIGN BASES

main.body: China's Shenzhou-24 spacecraft launched from Jiuquan carrying the first Pakistani national to fly to space. The crewed mission heads for the Tiangong station as Beijing widens its space programme to partner nations.
main.headline: SHENZHOU-24 LIFTS OFF WITH FIRST PAKISTANI

medium.body: The Saudi-led coalition struck Yemen's Red Sea port of Hodeidah after ordering civilians out. The Houthis threatened every Saudi Red Sea port, including Jeddah.
medium.headline: Coalition hits Hodeidah; Houthis threaten Jeddah

medium.body: Labour and management at Seoul Metro reached a wage deal on Wednesday, averting a planned general strike that would have halted the capital's subway.
medium.headline: Seoul Metro wage deal; strike called off

medium.body: Washington paused joint ops while it probes a 23 Sept raid that killed gang leader Carlos German Munoz Jara. US strikes have sunk 70+ boats, killing 240+.
medium.headline: US pauses Ecuador military ops over rights concerns

medium.body: Army Sergeant Jian Zhao pleaded guilty to taking photos of restricted documents and offering to sell computers and hard drives to buyers in China.
medium.headline: Soldier admits selling secrets to Chinese buyers

medium.body: Nvidia fell a day after its comeback rally, as CEO Jensen Huang told staff he made 'some terrible mistakes' and is in therapy. AI stocks dragged the market lower.
medium.headline: Nvidia slides 5.86%; Huang says he is in therapy

medium.body: Costa and von der Leyen host six Balkan leaders. A special summit Thu-Fri must agree the 2028-34 budget and a 45bn euro Ukraine loan.
medium.headline: EU hosts Balkan leaders as budget fight looms

medium.body: Moscow accused Kyiv of 'terrorist acts' after drone strikes on a Russian cargo ship in the Gulf of Finland and a warship off Benghazi. Kyiv called it self-defence.
medium.headline: Russia calls Ukraine ship strikes 'terrorism'

medium.body: Four people were killed and others wounded in an Israeli attack on a flat in western Gaza City, al-Shifa Hospital told Al Jazeera, despite the ceasefire.
medium.headline: Israeli strike on Gaza City flat kills four
